title: Lodi Kids Activities
description: Free directory of youth programs and licensed daycares in Lodi, CA. 72 tools.
summary: Free directory of youth programs and licensed daycares in Lodi, CA. 72 tools.
offersHint: Free directory of youth programs and licensed daycares in Lodi, CA. 72 tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://lodikidsactivities.com/api/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token for parent / org / admin scoped tools. Generate at https://lodikidsactivities.com/account/mcp. Public tools work with no auth.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Optional Bearer token for parent / org / admin scoped tools. Generate at https://lodikidsactivities.com/account/mcp. Public tools work with no auth.

toolsPreview.name: search_programs
toolsPreview.description: Search youth programs in Lodi, CA. Filter by free-text query (program name or description), category (Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, etc.), child age (integer in years — programs that accept that age), free-only flag, or season. Returns up to 15 matching programs with full details for decision-making (cost, schedule, location, registration status).

toolsPreview.name: get_program
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a single program by slug. Use this after `search_programs` returned a result and the user wants to know more — full description, schedule, registration timing, contact info.

toolsPreview.name: search_daycares
toolsPreview.description: Search licensed daycares in Lodi, CA. Filter by child age (in MONTHS — daycares think in months for under-5s), program kind (daycare / preschool / after_school), facility setting (in_home / center), or claimed-only (more reliable data). Returns up to 10 daycares with hours + tuition where available. For subsidy / bilingual / curriculum filters, follow up with `get_daycare` on a slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_daycare
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a single daycare by slug, including capacity by age band (infant / toddler / 2s / 3s / 4s / pre-K / kindergarten) when the daycare has filled it in. Use after `search_daycares` to surface specifics.

toolsPreview.name: list_upcoming_events
toolsPreview.description: List upcoming family events in Lodi, CA — open houses, workshops, community days, storytimes, sports clinics. Different from `search_programs` (ongoing classes) — these are single-day or short-window events.

toolsPreview.name: get_event
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a single event by slug. Use after `list_upcoming_events`.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: Returns the distinct program categories currently active in the LKA directory (e.g. Sports, Music, Arts, Academics, Swimming, Dance). Use this before search_programs to suggest exact category strings.

toolsPreview.name: list_cities
toolsPreview.description: Returns the cities Lodi Kids Activities currently serves. Today: Lodi, CA only. Other cities are seeded but inactive; do not surface as active to users.

toolsPreview.name: city_stats
toolsPreview.description: Aggregate stats for a city: # programs, # daycares, % claimed by owners, % with Spanish description, % free, category breakdown. Useful for AIs answering 'how many youth programs are there in Lodi' or comparing Lodi to other cities.

toolsPreview.name: list_guides
toolsPreview.description: Lists editorial guides published on LKA — parent-facing articles like 'How to pick a summer camp,' 'Lodi after-school programs by neighborhood,' etc. Useful when a parent is researching a topic rather than searching a specific program.

toolsPreview.name: get_guide
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full markdown body of a published editorial guide by slug.

toolsPreview.name: featured_listings
toolsPreview.description: Returns the currently-promoted programs on the LKA homepage. Reads from featured_listings table within the active date window.

toolsPreview.name: upcoming_registrations
toolsPreview.description: Programs whose registration window is opening soon (within the next 60 days). Useful for parents planning ahead.

toolsPreview.name: nearby_programs
toolsPreview.description: Programs within a radius (miles) of a lat/lng point. Useful for AIs answering 'what's near 95240' style questions. Uses naive Haversine — accurate enough for a single city.

toolsPreview.name: list_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Public reviews for a program or daycare. Returns rating, text, reviewer first name only, season. Used by AIs to surface parent sentiment when recommending a program.

toolsPreview.name: program_events_feed
toolsPreview.description: Upcoming events (practices, games, scrimmages, cancellations) for a specific program. Returns next 30 days. Use this to answer 'is there a game this Saturday?' style questions, and to power Add-to-Calendar flows.

toolsPreview.name: site_directory
toolsPreview.description: Structured map of LKA's public URLs and content sections. Equivalent to llms.txt — gives an AI grounding agent the full topology of the site so it knows what's worth crawling/calling.

toolsPreview.name: parent_list_saves
toolsPreview.description: Returns the signed-in parent's saved (hearted) programs AND daycares. Each row has a `kind` field of 'program' or 'daycare' so callers can route to the right detail page. Previously this tool returned `{program_id: null}` for daycare rows with no other data — a hangover from when only programs could be saved.

toolsPreview.name: parent_save_program
toolsPreview.description: Save a program to the parent's hub. Accepts either the program UUID or its slug (e.g. 'youth-soccer-league'). Optionally associate the save with one or more specific kids (by UUID or name) so the kid filter in /account → Saved Programs picks it up. Requires consent.

toolsPreview.name: parent_unsave_program
toolsPreview.description: Remove a saved program from the parent's hub. Accepts either the program UUID or its slug. Requires consent.

toolsPreview.name: parent_list_kids
toolsPreview.description: Returns the parent's kids on file (names + ages, no PII beyond what they shared).

toolsPreview.name: parent_add_kid
toolsPreview.description: Add a kid to the parent's account. Requires consent.

toolsPreview.name: parent_list_tours
toolsPreview.description: Returns the parent's daycare tour requests with status.

toolsPreview.name: org_list_leads
toolsPreview.description: Returns recent daycare leads + program saves for the org.

toolsPreview.name: org_list_programs
toolsPreview.description: Returns the org's programs.

toolsPreview.name: org_update_program_capacity
toolsPreview.description: Set the listing status on a program (accepting / full / waitlist_only / closed_for_season). Requires consent.

toolsPreview.name: org_reply_to_review
toolsPreview.description: Post an org response to a review. Requires consent. Replies are one-shot per review.

toolsPreview.name: parent_me
toolsPreview.description: Returns the signed-in parent's profile + preferences.

toolsPreview.name: parent_update_prefs
toolsPreview.description: Update parent notification + language preferences.

toolsPreview.name: parent_update_kid
toolsPreview.description: Update a kid record (birthdate, interests, school, special_needs).

toolsPreview.name: parent_remove_kid
toolsPreview.description: Remove a kid from the parent's account. Irreversible — deletes the kid record and any kid-linked enrollments/reviews remain but become orphaned (kid_id set null).

toolsPreview.name: parent_list_enrollments
toolsPreview.description: Returns the parent's enrollments (programs their kid is signed up for).

toolsPreview.name: parent_report_enrollment
toolsPreview.description: Self-report that the parent enrolled their kid in a program outside the LKA RegFlow ('I'm In'). Accepts program UUID or slug.

toolsPreview.name: parent_save_daycare
toolsPreview.description: Save a daycare to the parent's hub.

toolsPreview.name: parent_submit_review
toolsPreview.description: Submit a review for a program or daycare. One review per (parent, program). Use parent_update_review to edit afterward.

toolsPreview.name: parent_my_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Reviews the parent has submitted.

toolsPreview.name: parent_my_household
toolsPreview.description: Returns the parent's household members + shared kids. If no household exists yet, returns null.

toolsPreview.name: parent_invite_household_member
toolsPreview.description: Invite a co-parent / partner / grandparent to share this household. They receive a one-time invite link by email; on accept, they join the household and can see all kids + saves.

toolsPreview.name: parent_accept_household_invite
toolsPreview.description: Accept a household invite using the token from the invite link.

toolsPreview.name: parent_leave_household
toolsPreview.description: Leave the current household. If you're the owner and there are other members, ownership transfers to the longest-tenured member.

toolsPreview.name: parent_my_upcoming_events
toolsPreview.description: Upcoming program events (practices, games, scrimmages) for the parent's enrolled programs. Covers next 30 days by default. Cancellations included as 'canceled' status.

toolsPreview.name: parent_calendar_subscribe_url
toolsPreview.description: Returns the parent's personal iCal feed URL — subscribe in Google/Apple/Outlook Calendar to see practices + games in your normal calendar app. Refreshes hourly.

toolsPreview.name: parent_request_tour
toolsPreview.description: Submit a daycare tour request. Returns the tour id + status='requested'.

toolsPreview.name: parent_cancel_tour
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a tour request you previously submitted.

toolsPreview.name: parent_my_waitlist_positions
toolsPreview.description: Daycare waitlists the parent is on, with current position.

toolsPreview.name: parent_my_applications
toolsPreview.description: Daycare applications the parent has submitted.

toolsPreview.name: parent_recommended_for_me
toolsPreview.description: Programs matched to the parent's primary kid's age + interests. Simple matcher today — surfaces top 10 active programs that include the kid's age in their range, weighted by interest overlap.

toolsPreview.name: parent_export_my_data
toolsPreview.description: Export everything LKA has on you in a single JSON payload (kids, saves, enrollments, tours, reviews, household membership).

toolsPreview.name: parent_revoke_my_tokens
toolsPreview.description: Revoke ALL MCP tokens issued under your parent account. Use this if you suspect an AI agent has misused your access.

toolsPreview.name: org_dashboard
toolsPreview.description: Org dashboard summary — program count, leads in last 7d, new saves in last 7d, listing-status breakdown.

toolsPreview.name: org_update_profile
toolsPreview.description: Update the org's profile (website, phone, email, logo_url, instagram).

toolsPreview.name: org_update_program
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing program's editable fields.

toolsPreview.name: org_archive_program
toolsPreview.description: Soft-archive a program (active=false). Hides from public directory but preserves history.

toolsPreview.name: org_confirm_listing_fresh
toolsPreview.description: Confirm a program listing is still accurate (resets the stale-nudge timer).

toolsPreview.name: org_list_program_events
toolsPreview.description: List upcoming events for a program owned by this org.

toolsPreview.name: org_add_program_event
toolsPreview.description: Add a single event (practice, game, scrimmage, picture day, cancellation, etc.) to a program's calendar.

toolsPreview.name: org_cancel_program_event
toolsPreview.description: Mark a program event as canceled. Enrolled parents see this in their hub + iCal.

toolsPreview.name: org_analytics
toolsPreview.description: Org-level analytics — page views, saves, contacts in a date window.

toolsPreview.name: org_generate_promo_kit_url
toolsPreview.description: Returns a URL to the org's downloadable promo kit (QR poster + share card) for a given program.

toolsPreview.name: daycare_capacity
toolsPreview.description: Get current capacity by age band for the daycare(s) this org owns.

toolsPreview.name: daycare_set_capacity
toolsPreview.description: Upsert capacity for one age band on a daycare. Age bands: infant, toddler, twos, threes, fours, prek, kindergarten.

toolsPreview.name: daycare_list_tours
toolsPreview.description: Tour requests for the org's daycare(s).

toolsPreview.name: daycare_respond_to_tour
toolsPreview.description: Respond to a tour request — confirm with a date/time, propose alternates via notes, or decline.

toolsPreview.name: daycare_list_waitlist
toolsPreview.description: Current waitlist queue for the org's daycare.

toolsPreview.name: daycare_list_applications
toolsPreview.description: Submitted applications for the org's daycare.

toolsPreview.name: admin_pending_claims
toolsPreview.description: Pending org + daycare claim REQUESTS (someone applied to claim but admin hasn't approved). Excludes the long tail of seed orgs that have no contact info yet.

toolsPreview.name: admin_pending_discoveries
toolsPreview.description: Pending discoveries in admin queue.

toolsPreview.name: admin_pending_guides
toolsPreview.description: Pending editorial guide drafts.

toolsPreview.name: admin_cost_summary
toolsPreview.description: Month-to-date spend across Anthropic / Firecrawl / Serper / Apify / Resend / Twilio (when each logger is in place).

toolsPreview.name: admin_mcp_stats
toolsPreview.description: MCP call volume + top tools + top agents in the last 7 days.

toolsPreview.name: admin_live_activity
toolsPreview.description: Last 24h of activity across the platform — signups, saves, contacts, claims, discoveries.

toolsPreview.name: admin_search_trends
toolsPreview.description: Top parent search queries in the last 30d. Reads parent_search_queries.
